page.layout: One printed page on the scan, framed by a decorative woodcut border. Running text in one column inside the border. No margin notes. Page number and running title at the head above the border. Digitiser's footer and a partial facing page at the right edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: taq; argumentum non tàm diluitur, quam retorquetur. Hinc enim apparet, esse aliquem concessum modum, & rationem Deo non adversantem ditescendi, quâ aurum & argentum non more communi, sed per scientiam exsortem, δεσμοτον, non Diabolicam, multiplicari possit, licet Salomoni, si respicias conditionem ipsius voti, hæc scientia atq; exsors ditescendi ratio perinde fuerit ignota, atq; hodie paucissimis est pervia. Atq; hinc suspicari licet, cur de fossilibus, & rebus metallicis, sicut de vegetabilibus & animalibus expresse disseruisse non legatur. page.notes: The Greek word in the line "δεσμοτον" is a small-type Greek word printed as shown; it is doubtful and may be misread. The first line of the text is a continuation from the previous page, beginning with a fragment "taq;". Line-end "cer-" continues onto the next page.
